vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --stats_text --quiet --force_overwrite --mask_header_cache_path --dir_plugins {plugins} --plugin LoF,loftee_path:{plugins},human_ancestor_fa:{corpus}/plugin_data/human_ancestor.fa.gz,gerp_bigwig:{corpus}/plugin_data/gerp_conservation_scores.homo_sapiens.GRCh38.bw [--tab|--vcf|--json]
plugin_source: LoF.pm and the files it loads, of the LOFTEE repository (https://github.com/konradjk/loftee) at its grch38 branch, commit a46b502a68c812c8ae0c5a5721c0603fe81cae8d (tag v1.0.4_GRCh38), mounted as --dir_plugins and named by loftee_path through {plugins}; its maxEntScan directory holds the stand-in files scripts/data/write_loftee_stand_ins.py writes
input: 24 ClinVar records on chromosome 21 (public ClinVar identifiers; INFO dropped) chosen from a LoFTEE run over the whole chromosome so that every verdict class the plugin writes appears at least once, plus one constructed record (nagnag_acceptor, the A of a JAM2 acceptor AG that a second AG follows three bases on) whose NAGNAG_SITE motif ends the 9-base context the plugin reads, where the ClinVar NAGNAG_SITE record's motif opens it: high-confidence stop-gained, frameshift, splice-donor and splice-acceptor calls; the END_TRUNC, 5UTR_SPLICE, 3UTR_SPLICE and GC_TO_GT_DONOR filters, alone and beside high-confidence rows of the same record; the SINGLE_EXON, NON_CAN_SPLICE, NAGNAG_SITE and NO_EXON_NUMBER flags; two records whose loss-of-function consequence carries no exon number; and a missense and a synonymous record the plugin leaves alone. No record's loss-of-function allele is the ancestral base, and no END_TRUNC decision lies within 40 GERP units of the -58 cutoff.
generator: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 (the record spans); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --gerp-name gerp_conservation_scores.homo_sapiens.GRCh38.bw (the reference, the ancestral-allele FASTA and the GERP bigWig cut to the regions the run reads, the bigWig under the name LoFTEE's grch38 branch derives from loftee_path and without zoom levels so a summary read totals the per-base values exactly); scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --dir-plugins <loftee checkout> (the manifest's run, Ensembl VEP's LoF plugin at the grch38 branch of its repository reading loftee_path and --dir_plugins through {plugins}); tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --dataset loftee=<reference>=<candidates> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers LoFTEE --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=... --fasta-name reference.fa.gz and classify (the manifest's run and every flag set)
